summary_en: The caller initiated the call but stated they were currently busy and requested a callback later. The agent acknowledged the request and asked for a preferred time to call back. The agent confirmed that the callback request was noted and ended the call.
next_action: Agent to call back the caller at a later time as requested.
objections: Caller stated they are busy and asked to be called back later.
